suite.scope: Manifest file pin checked; frozen parameter identity read from each actual smoke

limitations: Only initial Task0 first-step recorded tensors are compared; no evolving-task equivalence claim.
Differences are measured, not classified as harmless or used to relax any campaign gate.
Selected third probe and U are outside this g012 snapshot scope.
Missing sidecar identity/config fields are reported as null; true is never inferred from absence.
relative L2 and cosine are null for a zero denominator; FP64 sums can have reduction rounding.
Exact is numerical torch.equal; bitwise_exact separately follows recorded byte hashes.
Normalized q is reconstructed on CPU from saved gradients; actual deltaPhi2 separately records executed geometry.
Frozen model/data values are verified via recorded hashes, not copied full pretrained tensors or images.
